## Checklist

- [ ] Added or updated tests, and `pnpm test` passes (plus `pnpm test:linux` on Windows, and the Playwright tests if `packages/desktop` changed)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm format:check` pass
- [ ] ADR impact considered: no ADR in `docs/adr/` is contradicted, or I added or amended one
- [ ] GLOSSARY updated if I introduced or changed a term in `GLOSSARY.md`
- [ ] `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` regenerated if dependencies changed or code was copied from another project
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal paths in the diff
